kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننهلك (form VII)
# نَنْهَلِكُ (nanhaliku) /nan.ha.li.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# نَنْهَلِكَ (nanhalika) /nan.ha.li.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
# نَنْهَلِكْ (nanhalik) /nan.ha.lik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَلَكَ (inhalaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
